data.name: Weather Master
data.description: Element air; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 0 By focusing on your connection to air and seeding the air around you for 10 minutes, you can create powerful weather effects, as control weather. You can create tornadoes or hurricane-force winds, as appropriate for the season. If you have access to the fire element, you can create hot weather, a heat wave, a thaw, or an early spring. If you have access to the water element, you can create all other types of weather listed in control weather.
